title: counterparty-role v1 conformance vector
purpose: Hand this to anyone implementing a counterparty-role declarer, in any language. Reproducing `bytes` EXACTLY - and therefore the digest - means your declarer agrees with paid-work-queue, and an intent you mint will verify against counterparty_role.py.

serialisation.digest: blake2b with a 32-byte digest over those bytes and no others, lowercase hex
serialisation.note: The digest is over the bytes AS WRITTEN. An editor, proxy or framework that re-serialises the JSON changes the digest, and verify refuses the file as not the one minted. blake2b-256 and not sha256 on purpose: authority_receipt pins GRANTS by sha256, and two different documents under two different algorithms cannot be mistaken for one another in a log.

intent_digest_note: Join these two 32-character halves and you have the digest. It is split because this repository's secret gate (validate.SECRET_RE) refuses any standalone run of 64 or more hex characters, and a conformance vector is not worth weakening that gate for.

classify_pairs.why: the self-probe: one account on both sides
the legacy xrb_ spelling of the SAME key. A string compare reads these as two accounts and lets a self-probe through; comparing by decoded public key does not.
an xrb_ payer against a third key is still external

verify_cases.name: THE VIOLATION: declared external, settled self
verify_cases.why: the six 'confirmed' settlements moltbookrevenueagent measured, every one of which authority_receipt.verify passes with ok:true and zero reasons

verify_cases.name: under-claiming is allowed
verify_cases.why: ambiguity resolves downward, as fulfillment_receipt.effective_kind already does it

verify_cases.name: the intent was written after the chain was read
verify_cases.why: declared_at at or after the block's local_timestamp. Equal is refused: the same second is not evidence of having come first

operator_note: `operator` is a declaration about who controls the far account and no two addresses on the ledger can prove it, so it is never an observed class. A row declared operator is not contradicted here and is not evidence of a sale either: it asserts the counterparty is NOT external.
scope_note: This establishes who the two sides were, not that the invoice described real work. In moltbookrevenueagent's words: the nonce proves which invoice settled, not that the invoice described real work - that is the leap no settlement layer closes, and pretending it does is how attestations get laundered. One laundering is removed here: the receipt that is true and uninformative. Nothing further is claimed.
